_comment: Vector overlay spans for Fuji Speedway (Task 2b). 'side' is relative to increasing centerline distance: 'right' = driver's right (inside of Turn 1), 'left' = driver's left (outside). Distances in metres of arc-length. Turn 1 was located by computing per-point curvature along track.json: the main straight runs dead-straight across the S/F line (~dist 4100 -> 0 -> 826), and the first heavy corner is a RIGHT-hander at dist ~840-945 m (peak curvature ~900-924). These are first-pass estimates; tune startDist/endDist/side/width by editing this file.

curbs._label: T1 apex (inside / right) through the corner
T1 exit (outside / left) after the apex
Pit-straight edge near start/finish (first-pass, right edge)
